concepts.title: True pentagonal base
concepts.instruction: Construct the 20 mm regular pentagon in plan with the specified base side perpendicular to XY.

concepts.title: Reference elevation
concepts.instruction: Project the five vertices and set the 70 mm height.

concepts.title: Plan bounding rectangle
concepts.instruction: Enclose the pentagon and retain the perpendicular offsets of its vertices.

concepts.title: Isometric base construction
concepts.instruction: Draw the isometric image of the bounding rectangle and transfer the vertex offsets to locate 1–2–3–4–5.

concepts.title: Prism generators
concepts.instruction: Erect the five 70 mm vertical edges.

concepts.title: Top polygon
concepts.instruction: Join A–B–C–D–E, then complete the base boundary and dimension annotations.

notes: The isometric side edges of a pentagon are generally not isometric axes: transfer coordinates/offsets from the true polygon rather than measuring 20 mm directly on every sloping image edge.
